LESSON: READING 15.2.1 READING FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.2: Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency, part of Strand 15 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What emotions or feelings can we display when reading a text? 2. Why should we read a text at the right speed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the reading fluency aspects such as accuracy, speed and reading with expression, and display them in a chart,

2. work with peers to find online or offline sample stories and choral verses on different subjects such as tourist attraction in Africa and read them aloud in turns,

3. practice the following fluency strategies as they read: - preview a text before reading, - skim a text to obtain the main idea, - scan a text to obtain specific details, and - ignore unknown words

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the reading fluency aspects such as accuracy, speed and reading with expression, and display them in a chart,
2. work with peers to find online or offline sample stories and choral verses on different subjects such as tourist attraction in Africa and read them aloud in turns,
3. practice the following fluency strategies as they read: - preview a text before reading, - skim a text to obtain the main idea, - scan a text to obtain specific details, and - ignore unknown words

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 15.2.1 Reading Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship: This is fostered as the learner explores texts on tourist attraction in Africa and this in turn enhances their global

awareness.

Values:
Peace: It is promoted as the learner avoids hurting others as they collaborate to recite the choral verses.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective communication: This is sharpened as the learner perfects their reading skills.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The concept of reading fluency is applicable in the learning of Creative arts and sports.
